title: 1 John 1:5 — God is Light, no darkness at all
summary: 1 John 1:5 quoted in English: the message heard from Him is that God is Light and in Him there is no darkness at all. The letters of 'Him' and 'God' are coloured individually (blue, red, gold) and 'Light' is gold.

text.text: 5 This is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you, that God is Light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

uncertain: Meaning of the individual blue/red/gold letter colours in 'Him' and 'God' is not stated on the slide.
